source_text: Proponents of medical circumcision argue that the empirical safety advantages and public health benefits, including averting an estimated 3.3 million HIV infections by 2020 through scaled programs, justify prioritization, particularly given documented severe wound infections and deaths linked to traditional methods in regions like South Africa and Eastern Cape.
